shared_contract.input_contract: Camera A RGB + Camera A K + identical dataset ROI

surface_budget.normalization: mean within each view, then mean across views

shared_contract.update_order: For each seed, independently shuffle all 180 frozen TRAIN rows once per cycle using SHA256(seed:update-order:cycle) into numpy PCG64; concatenate three cycles. S/M with the same seed use an identical order. Resume verifies the full-order SHA256.

selection_rule.per_run_checkpoint: minimum fixed-VAL subject-equal absolute exact point-to-triangle median, eligible only if P90 and P95 are each <= 1.10x Official and median coverage is no more than 0.02 below Official
selection_rule.arm_comparison: compare arithmetic mean of the two paired-seed best eligible primary metrics; M material gain requires >=2.0 mm lower than S and M<=S for both paired seeds
selection_rule.diagnostic: translation-aligned result determines placement-only versus non-translation interpretation and is not used to select checkpoint
selection_rule.sealed_candidate: after arm winner is frozen, use seed 20260910 best eligible checkpoint as predesignated deployment candidate; seed 20260911 is stability replication
selection_rule.tie: absolute arm difference <2.0 mm => NO_MATERIAL_MULTIVIEW_GAIN; select S as simpler deployment arm

input_at_inference: one Camera A RGB + K + dataset-provided ROI; strict exact freeze also requires an Official reference pass on the same input
